summary: I'm Hristo — a full-stack developer from Sofia with more than a decade of shipping web software, the last several years as an independent contractor for product companies across Europe and the US. My center of gravity is the frontend: React, TypeScript and the craft of interfaces that are fast, accessible and pleasant to use.

What sets my work apart is the combination of engineering depth and product care. I have built and operated APIs, databases, CI/CD pipelines and test suites, so the frontends I deliver are not just pretty — they are observable, testable and cheap to change. I work best embedded in a team, communicating openly and often.
If you are looking for someone who treats your product like their own — from the architecture diagram to the last hover state — we will get along great.

bullets: Design and build React/Next.js frontends and Node.js services for clients in fintech, e-commerce and SaaS.
Own features end to end: architecture, implementation, testing with Jest and Playwright, CI/CD and production monitoring.
Help teams raise their quality bar through code reviews, refactoring plans and mentoring.
Led the incremental migration of a large legacy UI to React and TypeScript with zero downtime for customers.
Built the shared component library and design system used by three product teams.
Introduced unit and end-to-end test suites that cut regression bugs to a fraction.
Delivered dozens of client projects — marketing sites, booking platforms, internal tools — on tight deadlines.
Worked across the stack: JavaScript frontends, Node.js and PHP backends, MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Maintained backend services and internal tools — and fell in love with the web platform for good.

beyond.title: Beyond the code
beyond.text: When I'm not shipping features I tinker with my homelab, contribute fixes to open-source libraries I rely on, and mentor junior developers. Coffee-fueled refactoring is my idea of a good morning.
